name: agentic-atlas
description: Profile agentic development methodologies, frameworks, and skill collections on axes that can help you decide if it would work well for you or your projects. It has a deterministic engine with an open rubric that is versioned and community driven. We provide hosted profiles of the popular methodologies but we encourage you to experiment and improve the engine and rubric to keep this system objective and useful for everyone.

interface.shortDescription: Profile agentic workflows on 13 signed, diverging axes
interface.longDescription: A deterministic profiler for agentic methodologies. Run a target, unlock classified axes, open the hosted Explorer, or ask how to read a profile. No API key.
